Birden fazla sayfayı ya da ders slaytını: Fit several pages or lecture slides onto one sheet; optionally open ruled note lines on the right.
Boş kenarlıkları otomatik kırp veya üst,: Crop blank borders automatically, or cut millimeters from the top, right, bottom and left edges.
Büyük bir sayfayı sütun ve satırlara böl: Split a large page into columns and rows and spread it across several sheets.
Tüm sayfaları seçilen kağıt boyutuna ora: Resize all pages to the selected paper size, centering them in proportion.
Slaytları sol yarıya (%55) sıralar, sağ: Places slides in the left half (55%) and leaves a ruled notes area on the right (45%).
Her sayfa hücresinin etrafına ince çerçe: Draw a thin frame around each page cell
Her kaynak sayfa {n} parçaya ({c} × {r}): Each source page is split into {n} pieces ({c} × {r}).
Metni olan sayfalar atlanır, bozulmaz. Ö: Pages that already have text are skipped and left unchanged. Recommended.
Önceki, kötü tanınmış metin katmanı deği: The previous, poorly recognized text layer is replaced.
Her sayfa resme çevrilip yeniden tanınır: Every page is converted to an image and recognized again. The file may grow.
Bu PDF'te zaten metin var; metinli sayfa: This PDF already has text, so pages with text are skipped. To recognize all pages again, choose "Redo old OCR" or "Force".
This PDF has no text: it looks scanned.
Eksik motor: {names}. Ayarlar sayfasında: Missing engine: {names}. See the install command on the Settings page.
Eğik taranmış sayfalar düzeltilir, yan d: Skewed scanned pages are straightened and sideways pages are rotated. Each page takes a few seconds; it can be cancelled.
Yazılar, paragraflar, tablolar ve resiml: Text, paragraphs, tables and images are transferred to an editable Word document (.docx). Page layout is kept as far as possible; on complex pages (multiple columns, nested boxes) small shifts may occur.
Taranmış (fotoğraf gibi) bir PDF'te meti: A scanned (photo-like) PDF has no text: run OCR first to recognize the text.
PDF'teki tablolar bulunur ve Excel dosya: Tables in the PDF are found and written to an Excel file (.xlsx), such as bank statements, invoices or price lists. Tables without lines are recognized from the alignment of the text. Plain text outside tables is not transferred; use PDF → Word for that.
Her tablo ayrı sayfada: Each table on its own sheet
Tablolar alt alta yazılır; sayfadan sayf: Tables are written one below another; a table that continues across pages becomes a single table.
Her tablo Excel'de kendi çalışma sayfası: Each table is on its own worksheet in Excel (e.g. S3-T1: the table from page 3).
Sayıları sayıya çevir (1.234,56 → toplan: Convert numbers to numeric values (1.234,56 → a summable number)
